title: Pensive Youth at Table with Tru-Action Game, 1957 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot dated January 1957 capturing a young person seated at a table with hand propped to their face. Beside them rests a drinking glass and the packaging for a classic mid-century 'Tru-Action Electric' board game. Greeting cards are taped in a festive vertical arrangement on the wall next to a hanging pennant and horizontal window blinds, documenting everyday domestic leisure in 1950s America.
